subject: Physics
questionText: What is the nature of the ray that emerges from the prism?

optionsList.optionText: The ray is refracted towards the normal
The ray is reflected back into the prism
The ray is refracted away from the normal
The ray passes straight through the prism without bending

correctAnswer: The ray is refracted away from the normal
correctExplanation: When light passes from a denser medium to a rarer medium, it is refracted away from the normal.
